youtube.title: This Map Is Lying To You #6 🌍 Which Is REALLY Bigger? #shorts
youtube.description:
Flat maps stretch everything near the poles. Watch each shape slide to its real size 🌍 Did New Zealand vs the UK get you?
Comment your score out of 4 👇

Follow for a new quiz every day! 🧠

#map #geography #truesize #whichisbigger #quiz #shorts

Data: total area in km² – India 3,287,263; Greenland 2,166,086; Mexico 1,964,375; Alaska 1,723,337; New Zealand 268,838; UK 243,610; Mongolia 1,564,116; Peru 1,285,216 (countries: CIA World Factbook; US states: US Census Bureau).
Outlines: Natural Earth (public domain). The shapes are moved on the globe and re-projected (Mercator) – no resizing by hand.
Music: original.
